t: Ghost Dimension: House of Fear
st: House of Fear
d: Located in Gran Canaria, there is one house that locals refuse to enter and that is, The House of Fear. Ghostly shadows, loud banging and demonic voices have all been reported here and the Ghost Dimension team will investigate these claims tonight.

t: Ghost Dimension: Last Orders at The Fleece Inn
st: Last Orders at The Fleece Inn
d: The team heads to Elland to investigate ghostly-goings on in this haunted pub. It's not just the spirits behind the bar lurking here. Multiple hauntings, murders and death surround this public house.

t: Ghost Dimension: Souls Seeking Solace Gotts Park Mansion
st: Souls Seeking Solace Gotts Park Mansion
d: The team encounters a spirit member joining them on the thermal imaging camera and appearing to leave its ghostly hand print behind.

t: Ghost Dimension: Underground World Of The City of Caves
st: Underground World Of The City of Caves
d: The Ghost Dimension team ventures underground to investigate the City of Caves in Nottingham.

t: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Dangerous Demon of The Stork Inn
st: Dangerous Demon of The Stork Inn
d: Sean heads to Wigan to investigate a location with history dating back to 900AD. Encountering a spirit that attacks him, will the team be safe tonight as they come face to face with pure evil?

t: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Buried Beneath The Bowling Green
st: Buried Beneath The Bowling Green
d: Buried under the location Sean investigates tonight, is the bones of the deceased and it appears that they are at unrest. Will Sean solve the mystery of who is haunting this location?

t: Ghost Dimension: Demons on The Buses
st: Demons on The Buses
d: Hidden in St Helens, is a museum that is home to demonic and dark entities trapped inside of vehicles.

t: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Not a Very Fun Day at The Beech Caves
st: Not a Very Fun Day at The Beech Caves
d: Witchcraft, demons and ghosts have all been reported to haunt these caves. Sean investigates this network of tunnels deep underground and uncovers that all is not as it seems. This is not a day out at the seaside at Beech Caves.

t: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Ghosts of The Asylum
st: Ghosts of The Asylum
d: Paul and Sean visit one very haunted Asylum in Manchester and come to face with ghostly souls that are haunting the building. The Asylum housed the criminally insane and it would appear, as the building closed, some of them never left!

t: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: The Curse Of The Pendle Witches - Part 1
st: The Curse Of The Pendle Witches - Part 1
d: Sean heads deep into the Pendle Hills in search of the Pendle Witches that went to trial in 1612 and were hung for witchcraft. The investigation takes an unexpected twist with a stop at the New Inn, Pendles most haunted pub.

t: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: The Curse Of The Pendle Witches - Part 2
st: The Curse Of The Pendle Witches - Part 2
d: Sean continues his investigation of Pendle Hill and ventures even deeper into the hills. The night takes an unexpected turn with a dramatic ending, which he believes was caused by the witches.

t: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 1
st: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 1
d: Sean heads to the town of Morley to investigate the infamous Morley Market. A place once bustling with people from years gone by, it is now haunted by shadow figures, and they appear to want to make themselves known.

t: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 2
st: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 2
d: Sean continues the investigation at Morley Market and appears to be followed by a spirit person that wants to touch him and distract him from investigating certain parts of the main hall. Will he uncover who this spirit is?

t: Ghost Dimension: A Night at The Leeds Museum Part 1
st: A Night at The Leeds Museum Part 1
d: Four floors of terror! Objects from around the world are at home in the museum, but what is attached to them, which now roams the floors and corridors after dark?

t: Ghost Dimension: A Night at The Leeds Museum Part 2
st: A Night at The Leeds Museum Part 2
d: With activity sending the team into a spin on the top floor, is there something attached to the museum's main attraction, the mummy?

t: Ghost Dimension: Haunted Theme Park - Part 1
st: Haunted Theme Park - Part 1
d: What could be haunting an abandoned theme park in Lancashire? Ghost Dimension seek out paranormal activity in Camelot and they are in for a ride!

t: Ghost Dimension: Haunted Theme Park - Part 2
st: Haunted Theme Park - Part 2
d: Ghost Dimension continue investigating Camelot Theme Park, the UK's most haunted and come face to face, with a powerful paranormal entity.

t: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Historic Hauntings of Whittington Castle - Part 1
st: Historic Hauntings of Whittington Castle - Part 1
d: Sean heads to Oswestry to investigate claims of hauntings at a castle thousands of years old, and believed to be haunted by an angry judge. Will any of the souls that departed here come out to play?

t: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Historic Hauntings of Whittington Castle - Part 2
st: Historic Hauntings of Whittington Castle - Part 2
d: Sean continues his investigation of the castle and attempts to make contact with the spirit world. It appears he is not alone.

t: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Haunting of The Sad Cavalier at The Ring O Bells - Part 1
st: Haunting of The Sad Cavalier at The Ring O Bells - Part 1
d: Sean heads to Middleton, Manchester to investigate claims that a sad cavalier named Edward is haunting this location. Ring O Bells has also been used for druid rituals. Will he be able to summon any spirits tonight?
